info.name: Sigma360 Account Monitoring: Entity Management API

description.content:
### API Concepts
This API is designed to help you interact and integrate with Sigma360. You can use it to create new entities, receive notifications about changes to your entities, and retrieve information about your entities. All aspects of a Sigma360 entity can be retrieved through this API.

#### Screening
Screening identifies: risks, KYC details, news and other critical information based on the provided entity name. The results returned are determined by the pre-defined Filter Set (See below for more details).  

##### Monitoring
Monitoring will perform a continuous, ongoing screening function, where you can expect to receive alerts and updates about changes to your entities without needing to manually trigger a screening event.
An entity is under continuous monitoring if it appears in the 'Monitoring' tab and is not archived. Archiving an entity will suppress all alerts and updates for that entity.

##### Alerts
Alerts are discreet work items that bring a detected risk to an analyst's attention. You can find alerts in the UI's 'Alerts' tab. 
Every monitored entity will create alerts as risks are detected. When you are performing a one-off screen, you can specify whether or not you want durable, UI-visible alerts to be created. Alerts created in this way will be visible together with alerts created through monitoring. 


#### Webhooks
Several events will fire an out-of-band request back to your systems to inform you of data changes or allow you to take action.
1. Entity Updated - changes to Matches, Indicators, KYC data or News
2. Entity Creation Finished - a bulk entity creation job has completed

Note that all Webhooks fire against a url provided by you during onboarding. If you need to change this url, please contact Sigma Customer Success.

#### Filter Sets
Monitoring and screening both use Filter Sets to configure returns and manage true and false positives according to organizational risk appetite.
For detailed information on ‘Filter Sets’ - contact Support: [support\@sigmaratings.com](mailto:support\@sigmaratings.com).
Screening response data is organized by: Indicators, News and KYC details. 
For more information on Indicators, News and KYC data see:[Sigma360 Indicators & Global Data](https://6879283.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/6879283/02%20Product%20Documents/Sigma360%20Indicators%20&%20Global%20Data.pdf). 


#### Conventions and Definitions
All entities are identified by a unique Sigma360 Entity ID (URN). These are stable over the entire lifetime of the entity.

All dates are expected in RFC3339 format or part thereof, e.g. "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00".

All countries are expected to be in [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2#Officially_assigned_code_elements), e.g. "US", or "GB".
In general, when a filter is not specified, the default is to return all entities for that field.

##### Rate Limiting
By default, we impose a maximum of 100 requests per second per account. If you exceed this limit, you will receive a 429 response codes for the extra requests.
We encourage you to aggressively retry requests that were rate-limited, as these do not count against the limit. The limits 
do not carry over and do not have any memory of previous rate limit events. If you are consistently hitting rate limits, please contact Sigma Customer Success.

##### UI Only tasks
Certain administrative tasks are limited to the UI and are not available via API. These are:
1. Creation and maintenance of Filter Sets
2. Changing the group of one or more entities
3. Changing the Filter Set for one ore more entities
4. Review workflow


Contact Support:

 Email: support@sigma360.com
